title: The Natural History of Selborne
author: Gilbert White
description: "The Natural History of Selborne" by Gilbert White is a natural history book first published in 1789.
longDescription: Written as a series of letters to fellow naturalists, this English parson's observations of wildlife, plants, and seasonal changes around his Hampshire village created an enduring portrait of rural England.

authorInfo.bio: Gilbert White (1720–1793) wrote The Natural History of Selborne. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
